races.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict: This looks open but JAX EDGE and Binadham will find this easier than the handicaps they contested last time. Marginal preference is for the former, who won't be troubled by the return to 5f and has the services of a good-value claimer. Bonnie's Boy is also of interest. JAX EDGE BINADHAM (IRE) BONNIE'S BOY

races.title: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Nursery
races.verdict: DOWMAN shaped encouragingly making his all-weather debut when third of 13 here on his most recent outing and, with the race likely to pan out favourably for him back down in trip, he's fancied to register a first success in nursery company. Bladey Lady could be suited by the return to the minimum trip given her enthusiastic style and is second choice. DOWMAN (IRE) BLADEY LADY (IRE) URUMITA (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Undercover Affair (5/2), Urumita (11/4), Dowman (3/1), Roxa Love (4/1), Bladey Lady (8/1)

races.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: Improving 3-y-o FAHIDI gets the vote having pulled clear with a subsequent winner at Wolverhampton 3 weeks ago. Almekarem isn't the easiest of rides but there's no doubt he has the ability to win off his current mark, while Charlie's Choice is another who's more than capable with his yard hitting form. FAHIDI (IRE) ALMEKAREM (IRE) CHARLIE'S CHOICE

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: DANSEUSE 's debut third at Newcastle in May has worked out well so she could be worth chancing on her first run since. It shouldn't be too long before Bintnaseefa and Maneater are winning one of these so are obvious threats, while Don't Hurry Love is worth a second look on her belated return. races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
races.verdict: ANTHROPOLOGIST has thrived here of late and might be able to defy the handicapper again. Tex added to his many good turf efforts this year when third in a big field at Newmarket at the end of October and heads the dangers along with Zryan , who is well treated back from a break, and the selection's stablemate Raging Raj . races.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict: It might be worth chancing AMAZONIAN DREAM , a former C&D winner who hasn't been seen to best effect in recent starts and has dipped to only 1 lb above the mark he defied at Windsor in July. Courageous Sioux , an unexposed 3-y-o, Methgal and Slot are feared most in that order. AMAZONIAN DREAM (IRE) COURAGEOUS SIOUX METHGAL (IRE)
